data.description: 雷姆必拓改装野营房车后舱，圆形舷窗外是荒野落日染红的漫天风沙。趴在房车大床上，双手托着下巴，长长的兔耳在头顶前后轻摇，毛茸茸的白尾巴在背后翘起，狡黠地冲着博士眨眼。 她微微抬眸轻语——“野外生存指南第三条：在舒适的被窝里，猎人和猎物的身份随时都有可能互换哦，博士~！”
data.promptProse: Ray lies on her stomach upon the wide camper van bed, resting her chin in both hands with a mischievous wink. Through the circular porthole window, the setting desert sun paints the swirling Rim Billiton sandstorm in vivid shades of amber and rose.
data.animaCaption: Lying on the camper bed with chin in hands, she winks playfully against the sunset sandstorm outside.
